items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and John L. Jones, a different town.

ctx.x: Uh, Gahir, eh? They had two different guys? Yeah, they had two different guys. Yeah, so he got killed quite naturally in Sidney, and he knew he took his place. Yeah.
They had a lot of guys that played there. I know Danny Barker used to be there, and John L. Jones, a different town.

That was the whole job, huh? Oh man, it started at eight o'clock or four o'clock in the morning. Constantly playing. Never stopped, you know. I mean the trumpet would pick up one chorus, then the sax would pick up the next chorus. Did you make much money there?
